en-US.description: Copy and paste text, URLs, images, and photos across devices.
en-US.longDescription: Clipboard Remote lets you copy and paste text, URLs, images, and photos between computers, phones, and tablets over a local network or Wi-Fi. It creates secure device-to-device connections and transfers clipboard contents only when you request it.
